ns2:course.label: Medical Device Product Development
ns2:course.description: Covers the foundational principles for developing medical devices, clinical diagnostic systems, medical decision-making tools. The pathway from device innovation through clinical development to product approval will be the focus. Content for the course includes best practices in industry, regulation guidance for developing products, and case studies. No graduate credit. 1 TO 16 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Students may repeat the course in separate semesters up to 16 credit hours total. Prerequisite: Restricted to students enrolled in Carle Illinois College of Medicine.
